inlines.v: QUADRU'PLICATE, adjective Fourfold; four times repeated; as a quadruplicate ratio or proportion. QUADRU'PLICATE, verb transitive [Latin quadruplico; quatuor and plico, to fold.] To make fourfold; to double twice.
